_설명: 천일문 2권 워크북 Chapter 11 접속사의 Chapter Test 가운데 상관접속사·that절·간접의문문 문항을 변형한 것. 기본 15과 접속사[2] 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: both A and B / not only A but also B / either A or B / neither A nor B

questions.point_label: not only A but also B
questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: We were not only tired ________ hungry after the hike.

choices.text: and
but
or
nor
while

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법상 알맞은 형태로 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: My aunt can’t remember [[where put she the keys]].

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 생략할 수 없는 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: I heard [[that]] you met Sora last night.
They thought [[that]] the dog was following them.
He believes [[that]] his daughter can be a great pianist.
I hope [[that]] we’ll have a great time today.
We know [[that]] boy at the bus stop.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: [[If]] we exercise every day, we can stay healthy.
I will go camping with Mina [[if]] she is free this weekend.
You might catch a cold [[if]] you go out without a coat.
I couldn’t tell [[if]] he was joking or serious.
This recipe is easy to follow [[if]] you read it carefully.

questions.point_label: not only A but also B의 수일치
questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 너뿐만 아니라 미나도 장래에 의사가 되고 싶어 한다. (want, but also)
→ ________________ to be a doctor in the future.
questions.answer: Not only you but also Mina wants

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 그 서점이 어디인지 알려주시겠어요? (be, the bookstore)

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: That he is only 12 is very surprising.
She promised she wouldn’t be late again.
I knew that he was upset about the result.
They forgot my name was embarrassing.
The good news is that the concert will be held next week.

questions.point_label: think가 있으면 의문사를 문장 맨 앞으로
questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: I wonder if Jiho likes classical music.
If you see Sora, please tell her to text me.
My mother doesn’t remember where she left her glasses.
Unless you arrive in 10 minutes, we’ll start without you.
Do you think how tall the building is?
